fields.statement: Parked for after milestone 39 (owner: "Yes" to these coming later): move the application code out of internal/api. The daemon (daemon*.go, 6.4k lines; runDaemon 366 lines at daemon.go:94, daemonPoll1 267 at :1005), the run engine (run*.go, 10.6k), shipping (ship*.go, 5.1k) and the web handlers (web_*.go, which make internal/api import internal/web and tui/launcher) go into domain packages that depend on the projection interface this milestone defines, so api is the transport-independent registry again. It waits for that interface. Survey: ~/orchestrator/architecture-survey-2026-11-15.md, sections 1 and 4.
